What I build

  • Custom websites

    Fast, fixed-price sites that tell customers what you do, where you are, and how to reach you.

  • Mobile-first design

    Most of your visitors are on a phone. Every page is designed for a thumb first and a desktop second.

  • Online stores and payments

    Sell products, take deposits, or book appointments online with Stripe, Square, Shopify, or Calendly.

  • Local SEO and Google Business Profile

    Show up when people nearby search for what you do, on Google and in AI answers.

  • AI chatbots

    A chat assistant trained on your own business info that answers common questions any time of day.

  • Lead follow-up and automation

    Reply to new leads in seconds, send reminders, and ask for reviews automatically.

Stop losing leads to slow follow-up.

When someone fills out three contact forms, the first business to reply usually gets the job. I set up systems that reply in seconds, even while you're on a roof or under a sink.

How a project goes

  1. Free call

    Thirty minutes, by phone or over coffee. We talk about your customers and what the site needs to do.

  2. Fixed quote

    A written price and timeline. No hourly surprises.

  3. Build and review

    You see real pages early and give feedback in rounds.

  4. Launch and support

    I handle hosting and your domain, then stick around with a 30-day warranty and optional monthly care.
